booking.note: Verbatim: 'campsites can, and should be, reserved until 11pm ET on the date of arrival' and 'Indiana is 100% reservable until 11pm ET on the day of arrival' - no sites are held back for walk-ins. Walk-in registration is still accepted on the day of arrival only, with the camper present, but is being phased out and guarantees nothing. Weekend rule: a Friday night must include Thursday or Saturday; a Saturday night must include Friday or Sunday. The One-Night Relaxed Rule waives that for sites still unrented 3 days out, but 'Required holiday minimum stays are excluded from this relaxed rule' - hence two rules, not one.

booking.source: https://indianastateparks.reserveamerica.com/brands/in/htm/CAMPING_BUSINESS_RULES.pdf (Minimum Stay, Maximum Stay, Minimum Booking Window, Walk-In Registrations, Opening Maximum Window)

fees.source: https://www.in.gov/dnr/state-parks/rates-and-fees/entrance-fees/ plus the $6 transaction fee in CAMPING_BUSINESS_RULES.pdf

booking.note: Flagship campgrounds (marked with * on the fees page) are 'premier facilities that provide premium amenities and New York State's premier scenic attractions' and carry a $3.00/night surcharge, carried in fees.surcharges.premium_site.

fees.note: Verbatim: 'Non-NY State residents will pay an additional $5.00 per night fee at camping locations.' PER NIGHT, not per stay. Cabins/yurts differ ($7.00/night or $28/week). NY has no resident/non-resident split on park entrance. Full per-night amenity schedule: Platform/Pad $3, Weekend/Holiday $4, XL Site+ $5, Waterfront $6, Electric 15/20/30A $7, Electric 50A $9, Oceanfront $10, Full Hook-up 30A $13, Full Hook-up 50A $15 - surcharges above carries the 30A figures, the 50A ones are +$2 each. HITHER HILLS IS NOT COVERED BY THIS ROW: it doubles the nightly rate for non-residents instead, and carries its own entry-level override.

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day

booking.note: CUTOFF UNRESOLVED - two Iowa DNR pages contradict each other and neither is obviously stale, so reserve_until is deliberately absent. iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-parks/make-reservation/overnight-camping: 'The last day to make a camping reservation, if paying by credit/debit card, is 2 days prior to arrival.' iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-parks/make-reservation: 'The window for reserving campsites is 3 months in advance and up to the day of to the arrival date if paying by credit card.' The 2-day version matches the 48-hour rule reported by AWH. FCFS AFTER THE CUTOFF IS ALSO UNCONFIRMED: no official page found saying unreserved sites revert to first-come at the park. What IS documented is that all campers must register, and that Fort Defiance and Preparation Canyon are walk-in only year-round. Resolve by phone (1-877-427-2757) before trusting either.

booking.source: https://www.iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-parks/make-reservation/overnight-camping and https://www.iowadnr.gov/media/7065/download (State Park Rules & Reservation Information) - see note, the two disagree

booking.note: Same-day booking closes at 17:00, but only SOME parks accept it - verbatim: 'Same day reservations are allowed at a limited number of parks through the call center and website until 5 pm.' Which parks is not published, so reserve_until is absent at the agency level and belongs on the entries once known. FCFS does exist statewide: 'Walk-in guests at parks and forests can request any non-reserved sites', with named first-come areas at Hart-Miller Island and Green Ridge State Forest (self-registration). Weekend minimum runs Memorial Day through Labor Day and must be Thu/Fri, Fri/Sat or Sat/Sun; holiday weekends need Fri/Sat/Sun. No non-resident surcharge found.

A Green Key card is required to use the reservation system at all: 'The Green Key card is also required to access the online reservation system for camping and marina reservations.' A non-resident therefore cannot book online without first buying one - see fees.prereq_pass.

prereq_pass.name: Suffolk County Non-Resident Reservation Green Key

fees.note: Family camping base rates per night, cash: Resident $18 in season (Apr 1-Oct 31) and $9 off season (Nov 1-Mar 31); Non-resident $36 and $18 - exactly double, hence the multiplier. nightly_low/high hold the RESIDENT base. Site-tier fees are extra and not in surcharges because they have no cross-agency equivalent: Premier $22, Tier I $11, Tier II $5 per night. premium_site $4 is the Flagship Park fee and applies only at Smith Point, Cupsogue, Shinnecock East and Montauk - NOT Indian Island. A $3 registration fee applies on top of the $10 non-refundable reservation fee. Green Key prices: Resident $30 valid 3 years; Non-Resident Reservation Key $50 valid 1 year; Non-Resident VIP $200 valid 1 year, which buys resident rates (worth it only above ~30 nights).
